title: SwingVision Match Quality Personal Best Detection
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swingvision:session
| sort 0 _time
| streamstats max(shot_quality_score) as prior_best current=f
| where isnotnull(prior_best) AND shot_quality_score>prior_best
| table _time surface shot_quality_score prior_best
description: Scans your swingvision match quality history in time order and highlights any entry that set a new personal best using the higher metric direction.
value: Automatic personal-best detection turns long history tables into a clean milestone log that is motivating and easy to review.
implementation: Keep the underlying metric normalized across sessions so the best-detection logic compares like events with like events.
visualization: Table of personal-best events with the previous best beside the new value.
grandmaExplanation: It warns the moments when swingvision match quality reached a new best for you.
